maddeler.e:
اغتفرت (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرْتُ (iḡtafartu) /iɣ.ta.far.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اِغْتَفَرْتَ (iḡtafarta) /iɣ.ta.far.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اِغْتَفَرْتِ (iḡtafarti) /iɣ.ta.far.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اِغْتَفَرَتْ (iḡtafarat) /iɣ.ta.fa.rat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
